title: nasturtium × capillipes
intro: Nasturtium × capillipes, commonly known as Garden Cress or Indian Cress, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is known for its peppery flavor and has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Nasturtium × capillipes include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce symptoms of arthritis, improve digestion, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glucosinolates, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-cancer, anti-viral, and anti-bacterial properties.
